spans.s: उत्फाल m. 1. A jump, a spring; 2. the jumping attitude.
उत्फुल्ल (I) a. (f. ल्ला) 1. Blown, swollen, full, open, e.g. हर्षादुत्फुल्लनयनः; 2. sleeping supinely.
उत्फुल्ल (II) n. The female organ of generation.
